confirm.title: Start the installation?
confirm.body: The changes chosen for the disk are made now and cannot be undone. Make sure you have a copy of anything you want to keep.

welcome.intro: This installer copies Soplos Linux to your computer, sets up the boot loader you choose and installs the drivers your hardware needs.

checks.title: Requirements
checks.diskDetail: {size} GB on the largest disk. {required} GB are needed
checks.diskNone: No disk was found to install on
checks.internetOk: Connected. The drivers and Soplos Welcome are downloaded during the installation
checks.internetFail: Not connected. It is needed to download the drivers and Soplos Welcome
checks.powerBattery: Running on battery. Plug in the charger: if it runs out in the middle of the installation, the system will not start

location.test: Type here to test the keyboard

bootloader.firmwareUefi: This computer starts in UEFI mode
bootloader.firmwareUefiDetail: You can choose any of the three boot loaders.
bootloader.firmwareBios: This computer starts in BIOS (legacy) mode
bootloader.firmwareBiosDetail: With BIOS only GRUB and Limine work.
bootloader.grub: The usual one in Debian and Soplos. It shows a menu with every system on the computer.
bootloader.systemdBoot: Minimal and very fast. It starts the kernels straight from the EFI partition, with a simple menu.
bootloader.limine: Modern, fast and with the Soplos theme. Built and maintained by Soplos itself.
bootloader.secureBootNote: All three allow Secure Boot. GRUB and systemd-boot boot with the signature of Debian, for example with a Debian kernel. Limine is signed with your own key (MOK) from Soplos Kernel Installer.

modes.minimalDetail: Copies the system as it is on the image, with its kernel.
modes.standardDetail: Adds the kernel you choose and the drivers for this computer.
modes.fullDetail: The standard one, with the system brought up to date.

kernel.levelUnknown: The level of your processor could not be read
kernel.levelDetail: the kernel is installed built for it.
kernel.minimalNote: the kernel of the image stays.
kernel.loading: Reading the kernels of the Soplos repository…
kernel.none: The Soplos kernel repository could not be read. The stock Soplos kernel for your processor is tried during the installation; if it cannot be installed, the kernel of the image stays.

flavors.stock: The Soplos kernel for every day: balanced, stable and tested on the three editions.
flavors.bore-ntsync: With the BORE scheduler and NTsync: a quicker desktop and Windows games running better with Wine and Proton.
flavors.zen: Tuned for the desktop: low latency and a smooth response under load.
flavors.rt: Real time: for audio and video production and work that needs exact timing.
flavors.x3d: Tuned for AMD Ryzen X3D processors and their 3D V-Cache.
flavors.other: Another kernel of the Soplos repository.

disk.noDisks: No disk was found to install on.

modes.eraseDetail: Soplos takes the whole disk. Everything on it is lost.
modes.alongsideDetail: Shrinks a partition and installs Soplos in the space freed.
modes.manualDetail: You decide the partitions, their uses and file systems.

shrinkErrors.hibernated: Windows is hibernated or has Fast Startup on. Start Windows, turn off Fast Startup and shut it down completely before going on.
shrinkErrors.unreadable: The space in use of this partition could not be measured. It may be damaged: check it from its own system.
shrinkErrors.unsupported: This file system cannot be shrunk.
shrinkErrors.nosudo: The partition could not be read: administrator rights are needed.
shrinkErrors.full: There is not enough free space in this partition to install Soplos.

disk.encryptNote: A passphrase is asked at every start

problems.noRoot: A partition for the system (/) is missing.
problems.rootSmall: The system partition (/) needs at least {size}.
problems.duplicateMount: Two partitions have the same use.
problems.noEsp: An EFI partition (FAT32) for /boot/efi is missing.
problems.espSmall: With this boot loader the EFI partition must be at least as big as /boot.
problems.noBiosGrub: BIOS with a GPT table needs a BIOS boot partition (1 MiB).
problems.noLimineFat: Limine on BIOS needs a FAT32 partition for /boot/limine.
problems.needsFormat: /, /boot, /home, /opt, /srv, /usr and /var need ext4, btrfs, xfs, F2FS or JFS: mark them to be formatted.
problems.badMount: A mount point of data must be a full path, such as /mnt/data, outside the folders of the system.
problems.unknownFs: A partition of data kept as it is has a file system that cannot be mounted: mark it to be formatted.
problems.noRoomForSwap: With this swap it does not fit on the disk: choose “No swap”.
problems.mbrFour: MBR allows 4 primary partitions at most.

disk.backupNote: Shrinking a partition is safe, but back up your data first in case the power fails.
disk.newTableActive: New table (GPT): everything will be erased
disk.mbrTooBig: MBR does not support disks over 2 TiB
disk.manualHint: Create the partitions in the free space.

user.loginHint: To log in. Lowercase letters, numbers, - and _
user.hostnameHint: How the computer is seen on the network
user.sameRoot: Use the same password for the administrator (root)

problems.loginChars: Only lowercase letters, numbers, - and _, starting with a letter
problems.loginReserved: That name is already used by the system
problems.hostnameEmpty: Write a name for the computer
problems.hostnameChars: Only letters, numbers and -, not starting or ending with -

summary.rootSame: The same password as your account
summary.shrinks: {part} will be shrunk to {size}. Its data is kept.
summary.creates: {count, plural, one {# new partition will be created.} other {# new partitions will be created.}}
